title: Linear circuit evaluation is independent of the resharer
statement: Let $F$ be a field, let $\iota$ be a type, let $d$ be a natural number, let $R$ and $R'$ be resharers, and let $A$ be a finite set of parties. For every input assignment and every linear circuit, its BGW evaluations using $R$ and $R'$ agree as functions on parties.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ is a finite set of parties
